facts.material: printed circuit board assembly with push-button switches, LEDs, connector, on backplate and bezel
facts.function: control panel of an aircraft MCDU (flight crew interface); no LCD yet

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 8537 boards and panels equipped with two or more apparatus of 8535 or 8536 for electric control; Section XVII note excludes chapter 85 electrical goods from aircraft parts heading 8803
GRI 6: 8537.10 not exceeding 1000 V; 8537.10.91 other; other

rejected_alternatives.reason: Section XVII note 2 excludes electrical goods of chapter 85 from parts of aircraft
not a programmable controller; no processing function stated
not a touch screen input device
parts heading is for goods suitable for 8535-8537 apparatus, but the panel is itself equipped with the switches

missing_facts: Does the subassembly contain a processor or memory that would make it a programmable controller or data processing part?
classification.rationale: The subassembly is a panel populated with multiple push-button switches for electric control, heading 8537; ruling N348828 placed a multi-function control panel in 8537.10.91. No display or processing is present, so the other line is chosen.
